prompt: i have too many tabs open, close everything except the tab im currently reading

assertions.name: lists-tabs-first
assertions.description: Claude calls eyes_list_chrome_tabs before any close operations
assertions.check: Plan starts with eyes_list_chrome_tabs to see all tabs

assertions.name: identifies-current-tab
assertions.description: Claude calls eyes_context or asks which tab the user is reading before closing
assertions.check: Plan uses eyes_context to determine active/focused tab, or asks user

assertions.name: aware-of-index-shift
assertions.description: Claude handles index shifting when closing multiple tabs
assertions.check: Plan either: closes from highest index first, re-lists tabs between closes, or uses title matching
